methodology.scope: Public counters on linked brand, creator and media posts. Not attributed individual results or unique audience.
methodology.grain: One Instagram post, carousel or video per shortcode. Carousel children are not counted separately.
methodology.deduplication: Each post counted once globally and once within each project. Project totals overlap and must not be added together.
methodology.missing_values: Negative, hidden, absent and restricted counts are null, not zero. Totals sum only reported nonnegative counters.
methodology.likes_comments: Recorded likes plus recorded comments, including partially measured posts. Not total engagement.
methodology.video_counters: videoPlayCount and videoViewCount are separate source fields. Never add them together or label either as reach. Plays can include replays.
methodology.coverage: Likes and comments use all linked unique posts as the denominator. Plays and views use posts identified as Video; restricted posts have unknown format.
methodology.time_scope: Counters at collection time, not a fixed campaign window. No growth or organic/paid split can be inferred from a single public snapshot.
